From a plan to a price.

Draw it. Get your price.

Draw on your plan and QuoteCore+ calculates the measurements and price using your saved component rates. Roofs, walls, floors and more.

  • Digital takeoff: draw from roof plans, architectural drawings or satellite images. Use elevations for cladding and floor plans for flooring.
  • Roof Scan Assist: on a clear, correctly calibrated roof plan, QuoteCore+ can complete the roof geometry quickly. If plan quality or roof complexity makes the result less consistent, edit the takeoff directly in the same workspace. (Roofing only.)
  • Offcuts + cut list (long run): generate a cut plan while quoting to calculate how much material the roof really needs. If you win the job, installers can use the same plan.
